## History

Mrs. Spencer was responsible for transmitting the request for an orphan child on behalf of [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). However, a mistake occurred, and she arranged for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to be brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of the boy the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) had asked for. ## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

[Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is the child of Mrs. Spencer. Her mother resides at their family home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) visit her to sort out the initial adoption mistake regarding the requested boy. [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) remains part of Mrs. Spencer's household while her mother attempts to assist in resolving Anne's placement.

- Parent of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>
